slides.teacher_cue: What sound?
slides.expected_response: Students respond /s/ quickly and cleanly.
slides.correction_move: Model /s/, students repeat three times, then recheck.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /sh/ drift and delayed retrieval.

slides.teacher_cue: Play sat once, then replay only if needed before checking.
slides.expected_response: Students write sat accurately on paper or a whiteboard.
slides.correction_move: Replay sat once, then segment /s/ /a/ /t/ orally before checking.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can hold the full word from sound to print.

slides.teacher_cue: Play tap once, then replay only if needed before checking.
slides.expected_response: Students write tap accurately on paper or a whiteboard.
slides.correction_move: Replay tap once, then segment /t/ /a/ /p/ orally before checking.
slides.observation_note: Watch for sound order errors and missing final consonants.

slides.teacher_cue: Play map once, then replay only if needed before checking.
slides.expected_response: Students write map accurately on paper or a whiteboard.
slides.correction_move: Replay map once, then segment /m/ /a/ /p/ orally before checking.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can encode the medial vowel cleanly.

slides.teacher_cue: Play bat once, then replay only if needed before checking.
slides.expected_response: Students write bat accurately on paper or a whiteboard.
slides.correction_move: Replay bat once, then segment /b/ /a/ /t/ orally before checking.
slides.observation_note: Watch for initial consonant confusion when students encode from hearing.

slides.teacher_cue: Play hit once, then replay only if needed before checking.
slides.expected_response: Students write hit accurately on paper or a whiteboard.
slides.correction_move: Replay hit once, then segment /h/ /i/ /t/ orally before checking.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can hold a different medial vowel without drift.

slides.teacher_cue: New sound today. Watch my mouth and listen.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /a/ cleanly.
slides.correction_move: Model /a/ with short crisp articulation and have students repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel quality drift toward a longer sound.

slides.teacher_cue: Show the picture, elicit meaning, then model pie orally before revealing print.
slides.expected_response: Students say pie orally and connect it to the image before seeing print.
slides.correction_move: Model pie, gesture to the image, use a short oral sentence, then recheck.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students know the meaning from the image before print appears.

slides.teacher_cue: Use the picture first, model pizza aloud, then reveal the written word.
slides.expected_response: Students say pizza orally and attach the word to the image.
slides.correction_move: Model pizza, confirm meaning with the image, then repeat chorally.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students respond from meaning first rather than guessing from print.

slides.teacher_cue: Lead with the picture, teach puzzle orally, then reveal the word.
slides.expected_response: Students say puzzle and connect the meaning to the image.
slides.correction_move: Model puzzle, gesture to the picture parts, then repeat and reveal print.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether the oral word is secure before the written form appears.

slides.teacher_cue: Discuss the image, model price orally, then reveal print.
slides.expected_response: Students use price orally with meaning before seeing the written word.
slides.correction_move: Model price, point to the tag, use a short oral sentence, then reveal print.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether price is understood as meaning, not just repeated as sound.

slides.teacher_cue: Start with the pirate picture, teach the word orally, then reveal print.
slides.expected_response: Students say pirate orally and connect it to the image first.
slides.correction_move: Model pirate, anchor meaning with the image, then repeat and reveal the word.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether the image helps students hold meaning before print.

slides.teacher_cue: Say the sounds and build left to right.
slides.expected_response: Students map each phoneme to the correct grapheme.
slides.correction_move: Return to oral segmenting, then rebuild one sound at a time.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can hold the phoneme sequence in order.

slides.teacher_cue: Build the word from its sound parts left to right.
slides.expected_response: Students build pizza using the correct grapheme chunks.
slides.correction_move: Return to oral segmenting, then rebuild one unit at a time.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students hold the double-z chunk as one unit.

slides.teacher_cue: Build the word using the grapheme chunks you hear.
slides.expected_response: Students build rack as r | a | ck.
slides.correction_move: Model the final chunk ck as one unit, then rebuild left to right.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students treat ck as a single build unit.

slides.teacher_cue: Build the longer word carefully from left to right in chunks.
slides.expected_response: Students build pineapple using the full sequence of grapheme units.
slides.correction_move: Chunk the word orally, then rebuild one unit at a time from the start.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can sustain the full sequence across a longer build.

slides.teacher_cue: Track left to right and read the full sentence.
slides.expected_response: Students read the sentence accurately.
slides.correction_move: Model the sentence once, then return to one-to-one tracking.
slides.observation_note: Watch for loss of accuracy at the sentence level.

content_payload.text_content: Pat sat. Pat sat at a mat.

slides.teacher_cue: Read for accuracy first, then reread for fluency.
slides.expected_response: Students read the connected text with increasing fluency.
slides.correction_move: Support line by line, then reread the full passage.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether fluency collapses after the first sentence.

slides.teacher_cue: Dictate once, replay once, then check spacing and punctuation.
slides.expected_response: Students write the full sentence accurately.
slides.correction_move: Repeat the sentence, segment by word, then rewrite.
slides.observation_note: Watch for spacing and punctuation breakdowns.

content_payload.support_text: Notice how at stays the same in both words.

slides.teacher_cue: Say both words and notice the part that stayed the same.
slides.expected_response: Students identify at as the repeated part.
slides.correction_move: Model pat and sat, point to at in both words, then repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can notice the repeated chunk without guessing.

content_payload.support_text: The part ap repeats across both words.

slides.teacher_cue: Read both words and notice the repeated ending.
slides.expected_response: Students identify ap as the repeated part.
slides.correction_move: Model map and tap, point to ap in both words, then repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can notice the shared pattern inside the full words.

content_payload.support_text: The chunk ack stays the same while the first sound changes.

slides.teacher_cue: Read both words and notice the repeated chunk inside each full word.
slides.expected_response: Students identify ack as the repeated part.
slides.correction_move: Model rack and back, point to ack in both words, then repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can hold the longer repeated chunk across both words.

content_payload.title: Close the Lesson

check_items.label: What sound did we learn today?
Which word do you remember reading?

content_payload.notes_field: Keep the close brief and oral.

slides.teacher_cue: Close with recall, meaning, and confidence.
slides.expected_response: Students answer orally and show lesson recall.
slides.correction_move: Prompt with the first word or model a full answer, then repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can move from decoding to meaning.
